unreleased: Add a portfolio module (app/modules/portfolio): projects with a Czech and an English title, short description and text, a link, a status (live or in preparation), tags and a publish flag, kept in an order the administrator sets. GET /api/modules/portfolio/items and /items/{slug} serve the published ones in the visitor's language, falling back to the other language when a text is missing; administrators manage them, reorder them and publish or hide them under /manage. The migration adds the table and seeds five projects

Add the freelancer module with GET /api/modules/freelancer/provider, which gives the legal pages the provider's details from PROVIDER_* in .env (name, company ID, address, registration, email, phone, effective date) and says whether the minimum is filled in

Switch on the contact-form module for this site, with its page heading, introduction and note, the address that receives messages shown as a contact detail, and the confirmation email written in the first person

Contact-form module: GET /api/modules/kontaktni_formular/info serves a per-language page heading, introduction and note (the new `page` block of backend/modules/kontaktni_formular.json) plus public contact details - address, GitHub and LinkedIn links from CONTACT_ADDRESS / CONTACT_GITHUB_URL / CONTACT_LINKEDIN_URL in .env, and the delivery address only when `show_email` is on. Nothing is shown until it is configured
Switch on the CRM module for this site: its partner, task and invoice endpoints are mounted under /api/modules/crm and open to administrators only

Add a CRM module (app/modules/crm), for administrators only: partners with contact and company details, their tasks (status, price, dates), and invoice PDFs uploaded against a task - checked to really be PDFs and capped at 10 MB, stored privately under uploads/crm/ and served only to administrators through an authenticated download
